name: The author
note: Unnamed; a leader who knew Timothy (13:23) and speaks of himself as part of the group (13:18-19, 13:22).

name: The readers
note: A community that endured earlier suffering (10:32-34), is now "dull of hearing" (5:11), and is in danger of drifting or shrinking back.

name: Jesus, the Son
note: "The radiance of his glory" (1:3), who became like his brothers (2:17), the "great high priest" (4:14), and the "author and perfecter of faith" (12:2).

name: Moses
note: Faithful "as a servant" in God's house (3:5); a man of faith (11:23-28).

name: Melchizedek
note: King of Salem and priest of God Most High, who met Abraham (7:1-3); the pattern for Christ's priesthood.

name: Abraham
note: Who received the promise and paid tithes to Melchizedek (6:13-15; 7:4-10; 11:8-19).

name: Aaron and the Levitical priests
note: The priests who offered sacrifices daily and died; contrasted with Christ's one offering (5:4; 7:11-28).

name: The heroes of faith
note: Abel, Enoch, Noah, Abraham, Sarah, Isaac, Jacob, Joseph, Moses, Rahab, and many others (chapter 11).

name: Esau
note: Who sold his birthright for one meal and could not undo it (12:16-17).

name: Your leaders
note: Those who spoke the word of God to the readers and who watch over their souls (13:7, 13:17).
